description: Focused lower-bound diagnostic refinement for HTH Gradient Boundary Voting. The prior 6,562-set exhaustive calibration produced a very broad near-best basin but placed both border_search_fraction and minimum_span_fraction at their lower tested boundary. This small two-dimensional sweep extends only those critical bounds while pinning every other parameter to the prior winning configuration, testing whether the clipped boundary hides meaningful improvement before spending a larger refinement budget.
